title: Variance
description: A mod for adding a little more decoration to your world.
body:
![Variance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b39fff6c25864248881e2a6e78b8ec6072e13a7.png)

A mod for adding a little more decoration to your world.

Currently adds:

- 16 new wool colors
- 32 colors of Wool Stairs
- 32 colors of Wool Slabs
 

I'm planning to add:

- Missing variants of every stone (cobbled, bricks, smooth, polished, and slab/stairs/walls of each)
- Knitted, Striped, and Smooth wool for each color and slab/stairs.
- Concrete, Terracotta and Glazed Terracotta with the new 16 colors.
- New grass and foliage blocks
- New light sources
- Engraved Glass
